steps.title: Spine, backbone or spinal column

pins.name: Protection
pins.text: Protects spinal cord and spinal nerves.

pins.name: Support
pins.text: Supports the head; forms the body axis.

pins.name: Attachments
pins.text: Ribs, pelvic girdle and muscles attach to the column; important in posture.
